claim_boundary: This package upgrades provenance from placeholder to source-referenced working copies, but it does not validate dark-matter replacement, Pioneer-drag physics, or toroidal cosmology.
manifest_limitations: Hashes identify local working copies and source records only.
The visualization lane is separable from numeric residual and baseline-comparison gates.
No dark-sector, Pioneer, or cosmology-replacement claim is allowed while raw tables, observer-frame metadata, residual thresholds, and competitor baselines remain open.
